title: Distinguish pause, hold and cancellation
when: When the user asks to stop, pause, park, abandon or resume current work.
need: Freezing parks an item without changing its lifecycle; blocking records an unmet condition; cancellation abandons work. Stopping a steering session still owes safe handoff of live operations.
surface: Help helpers; Steer held-work and close-out instructions
gap: Review question: should Help translate stop this into the appropriate current subject and consequence instead of requiring users to know the state command?
